notes: v2.9.24: chart-visual patch only; trading rules are unchanged. Concrete zones are now shown as clean bright-yellow outline rectangles only: no text, numbers, price labels, extra breakout guide, or interior fill, so candles, moving averages, clouds and other indicators remain unobscured. Bowl-3 display now keeps historical similar breakout-pullback/EMA224-or-112 support locations instead of only the latest structure. It also fixes two causes of Bowl-3 tags appearing and then disappearing: stale Bowl marker data from a previously selected stock is cleared on stock change, and the daily chart now redraws when Bowl analysis arrives rather than only when swing analysis changes.
